safe-seller-toolkit 1.0.1 changelog

- Updated SKILL.md to increment the version from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1.
- No functional or content changes; documentation update only.

Safe Seller Toolkit 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides pricing guidance for used goods using category depreciation curves and condition grades.
- Detects and triages 9 major marketplace scam families in buyer messages, offering BLOCK/PROCEED verdicts and safe reply suggestions.
- Generates safety-focused meetup checklists tailored by deal value, with escalation for high-value transactions.
- Offers packaging, shipping, and fraud-avoidance checklists, including do-not-ship rules.
- Designed for casual sellers on major marketplaces; works offline, uses standard libraries, and ensures privacy (no logging).
